name: Monte Carlo Integration
aliases: Monte Carlo Estimation for Shading Integrals
Monte Carlo Integration — MCRT Estimation, Monte Carlo Estimation, Progressive MCRT Estimation
definition: A technique to estimate integrals by using probabilities, evaluating an integral multiple times at random points weighted by their probability density function (pdf) and averaging the results.
summary: Monte Carlo Integration estimates high-dimensional integrals by averaging random samples, distinguished by its dimension-independent convergence rate regardless of function smoothness.
